scene_summary: Two separated, distressed-looking foil-print fragments rest on a pale gray surface. The larger left fragment carries a cyan eye-bearing curve, a pink curl, overlapping fine print, and dense black mottling. Its dark upper-right rim forms a distinctly rounded corner. A smaller companion at lower right repeats the cyan-magenta print vocabulary. Broad negative space separates the two.
usable_surfaces: Dark rounded upper-right foil rim of the larger illustrated fragment

detected_objects.label: Dark rounded foil edge beside the cyan eye-bearing curve and pink curl
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A narrow charcoal-black foil border follows the larger fragment's upper-right shoulder, bends around its rounded corner, and descends along the right edge. It directly borders the cyan and magenta illustration. The polygon traces this physical rim rather than enclosing the illustrated face or its cast shadow. The smaller companion is visibly separate but is not mapped as an additional source feature.

complexity_assessment.rationale: Two isolated fragments and extensive pale negative space keep the composition minimal overall. The surfaces contain dense print and mottling, but that detail remains confined to the fragments. The treatment is pictorial and distressed rather than purely abstract expressionism; it is not compositionally cluttered.
